pnl.method: Method: realised PnL matches each fill against the oldest open fills of the other side (FIFO per symbol, in journal time order) at the fills' price and quantity, in the quote currency; unrealised PnL values the open lots at the mark; total = realised + unrealised - fees (fees signed as the venue sends them, a positive fee a cost: docs/venues/bitget-uta.md, summed over their coins without conversion). Fills before the window are not priced: the FIFO starts flat.
